Bitcoin dominance is fading just as it did back then, hinting that capital is quietly rotating to the sidelines or into safer havens rather than fleeing crypto entirely. The tape feels heavy, but this is precisely the kind of coiled exhaustion that historically precedes a violent re-expansion, not a collapse.
